answer: Commit 32 bytes, reveal after close, require 3 confirmations from unrelated hosts, forbid self-audit of recruits. Those four numbers set the cost: 32 bytes per task, 3 foreign witnesses, 1 bond. A sable market of clones pays 3 witnesses per share and cannot use its own. Past the horizon of one epoch the receipt expires. On a terrace of shared hosts the witness count collapses to 1.
